release_notes: 20 commits since 0.9.8.1. Headline fix: the 'Prefetch ignored.' blank screen - Chrome/Edge omnibox preloading cached the old die() stub and displayed it as the page until a manual refresh; prefetch requests now serve the campaign normally, skip only the click INSERT, and answer with Cache-Control: no-store so the real navigation lands in the stats. RBAC grows one-click role templates (Admin / Media Buyer / Video Editor / Developer / Custom fill the role plus the whole permission matrix) and server-side financial masking: show_costs / show_revenue / show_payout null the money families across metrics, charts, campaigns and offers, with save-guards so a masked editor load cannot wipe stored amounts; nav tabs hide on 'None' permission and gear menus filter per item. Also new: Keitaro-style Namecheap integration (zero-config DNS parking, domain purchasing, import, subdomain parking), quick cloaking targeting filters on the cloak card (GEO, devices, bot-ISP blocklist plus a global bot_isp_list setting), per-pixel CAPI event_source_url with {campaign_url}/{landing_url}/{clickid} macros (migration 22), a redesigned two-column Tracking tab with live widget preview, Keitaro-parity column set for Landings and Offers (visits, LP clicks/CTR, leads/sales/rejected/trash, Approve %, CR, EPC/EPV, ROI/ROI(conf)), and compact report headers with full-name tooltips. Fixed: generated snippets produced broken code (kclient-php nested open tag, back-button trap firing on Forward, unterminated concat SyntaxErrors), percent-encoded ad-network macros (%7B%7Bad.id%7D%7D) were never substituted, the Facebook Ads template now ships real Meta macros {{placement}}/{{site_source_name}} instead of the fabricated {{site.name}}, country names were hardcoded Russian regardless of UI language, es/zh/uk machine-translation howlers (CPC read as 'Communist Party', IP as 'intellectual property', GEO as 'orbital'), neon-theme buttons were unreadable, Geo Profiles / GeoSelector colors were light-only, and the country dropdown was clipped inside the filter modal.
